0022600100.text: The Utah Jazz (0-1, 12th in the West) host the New Orleans Pelicans (0-1, 9th in the West) in the second game of the Jazz's season, with both teams having played one game so far. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain) and Trey Alexander (out, knee bruise), and Tony Bradley is day-to-day with a quadriceps strain and is a game-time decision, while New Orleans has no listed absences. The Jazz lost all three meetings with the Pelicans last season, most recently 156-137 in New Orleans on April 7, 2026, and this season's series has no games yet.
